decisions.reason: As a close extension of the core reusable bulk-packaging range with its own product page, it fits the firm's manufacturing strengths and should support growth in logistics-intensive customer segments.
The bulk-container valve builds directly on the established container business, adds system value for industrial customers, and its dedicated page suggests the firm is actively commercializing it.
The used-packaging take-back service matches the firm's move toward service-based, sustainable reusable packaging and can strengthen customer retention even if it is still at an earlier market stage.
